نتمركز (form IIq)
# نَتَمَرْكَزُ (natamarkazu) /na.ta.mar.ka.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَرْكَزَ (tamarkaza)
# نَتَمَرْكَزَ (natamarkaza) /na.ta.mar.ka.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَرْكَزَ (tamarkaza)
# نَتَمَرْكَزْ (natamarkaz) /na.ta.mar.kaz/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَرْكَزَ (tamarkaza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
